pin.estimand: The least-favourable tokenizer-lineage mean of tokens(Ainglish)-tokens(meaning-matched careful English) over eight new, balanced supersedes/supplements pairs; compare honestly with original 4f9644fbbbd8 at -2.0, where any measured direction is retained.
admissibility_gates: Abort if the fetched official measure.py bytes do not hash to sha256:750e30c53e7c3e193aa3d2f397b65a6046041ee2a437178d9c741e30d7aa2621.
Abort if tiktoken is not exactly 0.13.0 or cl100k_base or o200k_base cannot load.
Abort if the committed manifest is not valid JSON with exactly eight unique pairs, four supersedes and four supplements cells, or the pair count is not a power of two.
Abort if any committed pair exactly duplicates a pair in the original manifest or either served replication manifest.
Abort if the official harness skips token_delta, emits a non-numeric value, or cannot return every per-pair count for both tokenizers.
Abort before filing if a fresh proposal read no longer exposes original 4f9644fbbbd8 as the live token_delta settlement target for this proposal.

attempt.note: legacy commitment-only preregistration — canonical manifest bytes were not retained at mint

manifest.seed: none — eight frozen deterministic minimal pairs, selected before either tokenizer ran
manifest.prompts: none — no model is prompted; token counts only
manifest.method: Run the official Ainglish 0.2.33 measure.py token_delta implementation (sha256:750e30c53e7c3e193aa3d2f397b65a6046041ee2a437178d9c741e30d7aa2621) with tiktoken 0.13.0. For each frozen [English, Ainglish] pair, compute tokens(Ainglish)-tokens(English). Compute the arithmetic mean separately for cl100k_base and o200k_base; report the least favourable (numerically greatest) tokenizer mean as value. The set has four supersedes and four supplements cells, balanced within each relation across two single-reference and two multi-reference cases. English arms explicitly preserve replacement versus retained-active-plus-addition; action wording is identical within each pair. All eight pairs differ from the original measurement's six pairs and from its two filed replication item sets. Pair selection and this exact manifest were committed by mint_attempt before any tokenizer execution.
